title: Multilingual and Multi-Accent Jailbreaking of Audio LLMs
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. The benchmark measures the Jailbreak Success Rate (JSR) of Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) when subjected to multilingual and multi-accent audio prompts with acoustic perturbations.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on security vulnerabilities in Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) through multilingual and multi-accent audio jailbreaks.
